Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have for you, folks! Another Test which gets done within four days. England win the series as they take a 3-1 lead. After a long series, we finally come to the last match of it. The action moves to Kennington Oval, London. That game too will begin at 1100 local (1000 GMT). Do join in for the farewell game of the tour. Even though the series is lost, Virat Kohli said they will give it their all, so you don't want to miss it. Until next time, cheers!

Man of the Match, Moeen Ali, says he's missed Test cricket and it's great to come back. Mentions that he needed a little break to rejuvenate and is happy he got that. Specifies that going back to County Cricket really helped, as when watching his national side teammates playing he felt like he wanted to make a comeback and that helped him appreciate Test cricket more. Feels like he's getting better with each passing day and just wants to continue with that. On batting at no.3, he mentions he was given a choice by his captain and he took it, also chuckles as he informs he enjoyed the 15 balls that he faced. Ends by saying that he doesn't care what position he bats in, just wants to contribute to the team and help win games.

England captain, Joe Root, says that Sam Curran has been superb throughout the series, so is excited for him and the team. States that the pressure is welcome and that his team knows how to handle it, so is proud of the boys. Informs that hitting the deck hard and just applying the pressure was the key, as that one ball can change the game completely. Adds that they would like to carry the intensity from this game forward. On Moeen Ali, he happily says that the experience from different places helps the players and this is the best he's seen Ali bowl in an England shirt. Is pleased that no matter how much the team order is shuffled, everyone is contributing and doing their part.

India captain, Virat Kohli, says England did really well to set the target they did. Applauds them for using the spinning conditions on offer to the fullest. Reckons his side didn't make too many mistakes, but the English team was relentless and deserves the credit for the win. Mentions that he never thought if the partnership between him and Rahane was broken it would be a problem, but no partnerships before and after that is a problem. Once again states that England put the pressure when the partnership was broken and took the game from there. Feels ifs and buts don't mean anything, plenty of situations could have been different so no point criticizing them. Adds they just have to take the positives and do the best in the next game. Further adds it's handy to have a few attacking players lower down the order when the bowlers are a bit tired, both sides have them but England's did better. Credits Sam Curran for the fantastic series he's having. Emphasizes that he and his team will not throw the towel in the last game and give it their all.

Sam Curran and Ben Stokes are caught for a chat. Curran says that he is happy to contribute with the win. On his batting, he says that he was trying to play his natural game like he does for Surrey. Ends saying that he was just enjoying the occasion. Ben Stokes gives credit to all the players. Mentions that the third innings was special. Continues saying that he put all the demons off his mind aside and looked to spend time in the middle.

This contest will have plenty of talking points, but one more than any other would stand out. Should India have gone with two spinners as well, given the nature of the pitch? And also, Ashwin's underwhelming performance seriously dented their chances as he fully couldn't exploit the conditions like Moeen Ali. A deserving win for Joe Root's England, they've nicked the vital moments and stood up when it mattered.

Come the third innings, England faltered at the top yet again, but Buttler, Stokes and the young boy Curran once again played their role to perfection and posted a massive target on the board for India. It was never going to be easy with the wicket turning so much, but despite losing their top order early, the tourists were actually on top till Kohli and Rahane were at the crease. Though, the moment their century stand was broken, the writing was more or less on the wall. Ali decimated the remaining Indian batters, finishing with 9 wickets in total in this match.

England were on the back foot with the top and middle order once again rolled over rather early. But vital contributions from Ali and Curran took England to a respectable total. Then when India came out to bat, all more or less failed, and had it not been for Pujara's classy ton, the match would have been over much earlier. He kept his side alive and competing in the Test.

So the final nail in the coffin has been hammered and the hosts take the series, leading 3-1 now. This entire Test match has been terrific all around, with the players' skill with both bat and ball being tested. Although, the difference-maker, it could be argued, was the contribution from the lower middle order of both teams. You could say England's contributed more, in particular, Sam Curran's role, which changed the game.

OUT! That's it. The inevitable has happened as Sam Curran, fittingly, plucks the final wicket. He comes running in from around the wicket and fires in a fuller length delivery on middle and leg, Ashwin moves across to flick it away but is caught low on the pads. A big appeal goes up and after a little nod from the umpire, so does the finger. The English team celebrates, smiles and handshakes all around. ENGLAND WIN BY 60 RUNS!
A bit short, slapped off the back foot to mid off.
Dropped! But a good try from Anderson. Length ball wide outside off, Ashwin looks to loft it over point. Anderson there leaps, sticks his left hand out but can't keep a hold of it. Tough chance.
Full in length and fired just outside off, Ashwin looks to hit it through the off side but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Spinning in from a shorter length, Ashwin waits for the ball to come to him, backs away and cuts it down towards third man for a single.

SIX! That's a mighty blow from Ravi Ashwin. He skips down the track, gets close to the pitch of the ball and launches it high and handsome over long on. Anderson is only a spectator as he watches the ball sail over his head.
Works it with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Stays right behind the line and keeps it out.
Full and loopy outside off, gets close to the pitch and blocks.
Brings out the reverse sweep and places it square through the off side. Will pick up a couple of runs for doing so.
Takes the pace off this one and deceives Bumrah. He swivels to help the pull but gets an under edge behind to the keeper on the bounce.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Opens his body up and pushes this full ball square to point.
Cutting back in, around off, kept out square on the off side.
Full and angling in around off, Bumrah initially wants to play at it but decides to let it be at the last second.
Comes running in from around the wicket and angles it in from outside off, Bumrah shoulders arms to it.
Sam Curran back on.

Almost got out! Ashwin kneels forward and across to play the scoop shot and mistimes it horribly. Lobs it just in front of the diving short mid-wicket fielder, who tries everything he had to get his palms underneath it.
FOUR! That's a very smart shot from Ashwin. Moves across the stumps, sees there's nobody out there so kneels down and sweeps it over the leg side. Easy boundary. 70 more to win for India.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Kneels down and plays the sweep shot to square leg.
Really slow through the air and almost beats Ashwin in the flight. The batsman manages to drive it off the inner half with one hand towards mid on.
Flights it up around off, on a driving length, Ashwin is well forward in defense.
Final Drinks break of this game. Game is more or less over, just a matter of time. England need only 1 wicket to win and it could come on the very next ball itself.
Full and outside off, Bumrah leaves it alone.
Full and on middle, Bumrah plays it with a straight bat.
Outside off, cut past point for a run to give Bumrah the strike.
Bangs this short down the leg side, Ashwin looks to hoick it but misses. An appeal which eventually dies down from the English players.
Back of a length ball outside off, Ashwin taps it to the off side.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Ashwin sees the gap and cuts it through cover-point for a good looking boundary. There were two men in the deep but he bisects them both.
Ravi Ash plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
On middle and leg, Ashwin flicks it to square leg.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Good shot from Ashwin. Uses his feet and lofts this over mid-wicket. The fielder from deep square leg runs to his left and keeps it to two.
Jasprit Bumrah is the last man in.

OUT! One shot too many and Shami has to walk back. Nothing wrong with the intent but finds the man in the deep. Similar ball on middle, Shami once again charges down the pitch and lofts it over mid on. Anderson from the deep runs in and takes the catch. England need just one more wicket to win the game and the series.
High but won't go all the way. Ali bowls this full and on the stumps, Shami lofts it over the bowler's head. It lands safety and they take couple of runs.
Ashwin shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short of a length delivery close to off, another defensive shot presented in response.
Outside the line of off stump, a play and a miss from the batsman.

Full and pitched outside off, room to swing his arms and Shami does just that. Looks to clear Southampton by going big downtown, only to connect with thin air. Stokes turns around and has a laugh as he walks back to his run-up.
Back of a length in line of the stumps, pushed tamely square towards point.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Spinning in on off, Ashwin moves across his sticks and flicks it in front of square leg for nothing.
Shami slogs this across the line. Clears the infield over mid-wicket and crosses over.
Quicker through the air on the stumps, pushed back down the track.
The straighter one outside off, Shami picks it up and blocks.
Loopy off break outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
FOUR! Well played! Width offered outside off, a touch shorter in length, Shami cuts it hard through point for a boundary.
Mohammed Shami to bat next.

OUT! Stokes strikes! The decision could be a bit dubious, but no reviews left so the umpire's call stays. Shaping back in on middle and leg, Sharma goes across to work it across the line and is caught on the pads. The finger follows after the appeal and Ishant has to walk back. Height could have been an issue, but we'll never know. England 2 wickets away from a series victory.
Outside off, Sharma withdraws his bat and lets it pass.
Short of a good length, quite close to off, Ishant plays it out from within the crease.
Stays back and keeps it out off the back foot.
Angling in on middle and leg, flicked away into the gap on the leg side for a single.
Sharma plays this with the spin and turns it away towards short mid-wicket.
Ishant Sharma is the new man in to bat.

OUT! Rahane is gone! Moeen Ali making all the difference yet again here. India, from being favourites, are staring down the barrel and this match could get over today itself. The offie lands it in the rough and it spins in a long way from outside off. Rahane goes deep inside the crease to work it on the leg side but is caught in front of the stumps. Big appeal and the finger goes up. The batsman reviews, as expected, and it's taken upstairs. Replays show three reds and that's the end of that. The end is probably nigh now for India.
The review is taken. No other choice either. Ajinkya Rahane is caught leg before and given out. He seems to be gone. Let's see here...
Extremely full outside off, driven neatly to sweeper cover for a comfortable single.
Quick, flat and short outside off, moves across and defends it down with soft hands.
Pushed quicker through the air around off, it's worked away to short mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, Ravi Ashwin walks out and defends.
Outside off on a good length, no shot offered to end the over.
Shortish in length, on the stumps, pushed back down the track off the back foot.
Just behind a length, outside off, blocked from inside the crease.
Just the one. Good work from Jonny Bairstow out in the deep. Ashwin taps this length ball down to third man. Jonny moves swiftly to his left and cuts it off, keeping the batsmen to just the one.
Angling back in on the hips, Rahane turns it through the vacant square leg position for one run.
Good length delivery close to the off stump, pushed gently on the off side.

Another needless appeal. Looped up outside off, Ashwin comes forward and across to block but is caught on the front pad. Impact clearly outside off. Nevertheless, end of a successful over from Moeen Ali.
Full on the stumps, Ashwin drives it back to the bowler.
Ravichandran Ashwin is the next batsman in.

OUT! One shot too many from Rishabh Pant and he's paid the price for it. Moeen Ali gives this more air and bowls it full around off, Pant once again steps out and looks for the big one. Lofts it over covers but there's a man there this time. Alastair Cook runs in and takes a good catch. Moeen, like in the first innings, dismisses the Indian wicket-keeper batsman again. Still 95 left to win.
Turning away from around off, played off the outer half towards short third man.

FOUR! This is what India would want from Pant. 'Constructive hitting', as Michael Holding on air states. Beautiful. Picks his spot well. It's looped up on the stumps, the southpaw takes a step out and blasts it over mid off, beating the man in the deep.
A little too full than Moeen would have liked, allows Pant to come forward and defend before the ball can even turn.
Full and swinging away from outside off, can't get Rahane to play at it.
Back of a length, cramping the batsman for room. Ajinkya Rahane stays back and defends it down on the track.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Rahane is watchful as he sees the ball landing outside off, so has nothing to do with it.
Short of a good length outside off, punched off the back foot by the batsman.
In the channel outside off, left alone.

The deficit is now in the double digits. Just 99 needed to win for the visiting side. Pant leans ahead and flicks this through mid-wicket. Big gap out there, so the man in the deep takes a while to get to the ball. Amidst all this, both batsmen rush and take the second run as well. The third umpire is referred as there is a potential run out at the bowler's end, but Rahane is well in.

Fifty for Ajinkya Rahane! His 14th in this format. He's deserved every bit of this milestone, has been flawless till now. Needless to say he's the foundation of India's potential victory, so has to keep going along as he is. He goes back and works this past short leg for a single.
Spinning in from a shorter length, Ajinkya is on the back foot as he punches it back in the bowler's direction.
Tosses it right up there, around off, Rahane defends this off the inner half to short leg.
Better. Driven this full delivery through the cover area and gets to the other end.

Loud shout for a leg before and it's turned down. Impact outside off again. Quite full from Moeen, Pant kneels down to sweep and misses it. Dangerous shot to play to that length and he's caught around the body, but outside the line. Good call.
Solid in defense. Jinx meets the length ball with the full face of the bat and taps it down in front of covers.
Makes it come back in this time, on middle and leg, Rahane does well to lean across and wrist it behind square leg. Calls for the second and gets it too. Nicely done.
Going away again, from a good length and outside off, left alone.
Pushes this towards backward point off the back foot.
Good length delivery on the fourth stump line, a hint of movement away, Rahane taps it down on the off side.
Coming in first before seaming away off the deck, Rahane comes forward and makes a watchful leave.
The off break outside off, Rahane uses the depth of the crease to go back and work it through backward square leg for a run. Moves to 47 with that.
Sensible stuff. Shows he isn't being reckless. Slower through the air on middle and off, it goes off the inner half on the leg side for a single.

SIX! Takes the attack to Moeen Ali and gets the desired result. Sweet connection from Rishabh Pant. Uses his feet to dance down, gets close to the pitch and smokes it downtown for a biggie. Safest places to take the aerial route. Excellent.
Works it off his pads and turns it on the leg side for a single.
Turning in, this time he goes inside the crease and keeps it out.
Spinning in from the rough from around off, Rahane comes forward to block, goes across a bit too but misses and is caught on the pads.
Moeen Ali to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Avoids the pair. This is the intent with which Pant should play. That's a good, positive shot. Fuller and angling in, the southpaw flicks it neatly through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Throws it further outside off, another good leave.
From around the wicket now, it's hurled in the channel outside off on a length, Pant lets it be.
Rishabh Pant walks in next to bat.

OUT! Clean as a whistle! No doubt about it one bit. Good catch by skipper Joe Root at second slip. Stokes angles in a length ball on middle and off, it angles in at first and then straightens up just enough to take the outside edge of Hardik Pandya's bat. Flies behind where Root goes low to his right and takes it. Hardik hangs around, wants the umpire to check it upstairs and replays show it's all good for England. India slip a little further. The hosts need just 5 wickets to win.
Pandya has been caught behind in the slips but the umpire wants to make sure if the catch is taken cleanly or not. The soft signal is out.
Short of a good length on off, not giving Pandya any room, he can only stay back and keep it down on the track.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Rahane runs it down third man for a single.
We are back. Rahane and Pandya will continue, looking to narrow down the deficit as much as possible from the 119 remaining. Ben Stokes has the ball in his hand. Two slips positioned for him.
... Day 4, Final Session ...

Session Highlights - 33 overs, 80 runs, 1 wicket. It has been India's passage of play but the wicket of Kohli just at the stroke of the interval has provided England a huge boost. However, it was a classic fifty from the Indian skipper and he has given his side more than a chance to chase this target down. Ajinkya Rahane is still out there and is looking solid as a rock. If the home side manage to dismiss him soon, the odds might tilt in their favour. Having said all this, the tourists hold the upper hand in the contest. They need 119 more runs to win and have six wickets in hand. Can they keep their calm and march on? Or will the Englishmen trigger a collapse and come back from behind? The final session shall reveal a lot. Join us shortly.
On a flatter trajectory, Pandya hangs back and blocks it nicely. THAT'S TEA ON DAY 4!
Tossed up around off, Pandya comes forward and blocks it.
Shorter in length, spinning in, turned around the corner for a single.
Slower through the air on middle, Rahane taps it behind towards leg slip.
Straighter this time, Ajinkya camps back and keeps it out.
Tossed up around off, defended towards short leg.
Similar delivery and Pandya gets beaten again. Stokes looks frustrated as he bowls a beauty but still does not get rewarded. Pandya survives but just.
Beaten! Peach from Stokes. Lands this on off and gets it to straighten. Pandya looking to defend it gets beaten by the away movement.
Stokes strays on Rahane's pads who flicks this one towards square leg for a single.
Stokes pulls his length back and keeps it just outside off, Rahane taps it towards the point region.
Lands it on a good length around off, Rahane blocks it out off the front foot.
Stokes keeps it outside off, Rahane shoulders arms.
Wide! Bouncer by Stokes but it is too high. Given a wide for height.
Ali floats this one fuller on off, Pandya comes ahead and keeps it out.
Hardik Pandya comes out to bat. He has been promoted ahead of Rishabh Pant.

OUT! Massive, massive moment in the game! The Indian captain falls. Ali has done the trick for the home team. Tosses this one up just around the off stump line. Kohli comes forward to block it away. The ball lands, grips, bounces and turns viciously to take the Indian skipper's inside edge onto his pads and in the direction of the short leg fielder where Cook happily accepts it. England appeal unanimously and Dharmasena  obliges immediately. Kohli is seen a bit confused as he points at his forearm. He feels that the ball may just have missed his gloves and hence takes the review, but in hope more than anything. Replays roll in. Snicko indicates the ball brushed the gloves and that evidence is enough. England get the biggest Indian wicket. Kohli's vigilant innings comes to an end, just minutes before the Tea interval with India still needing 122 to win.

This can be the turning point in this game. Kohli has been caught by Cook at short leg. He walks across gingerly to Rahane and decides to challenge the decision. His body language is not that good though.

Dropped!. But a very difficult chance though. These either stick or don't. This one is a bit slower through the air but a bit shorter in length on the middle and leg line. Kohli turns it away into the leg side. Cook at short leg, instinctively puts his hand out. The ball hits his hands and drops down on the ground. Technically a dropped chance but that would have been a lucky catch if it would have stuck.
Kohli flicks this full and straight ball to the fine leg fielder. No run taken.
Ali pulls his length back a bit, Rahane goes back and turns it with the spin towards square leg for a single.

LBW appeal turned down by the umpire. Ali tosses this one outside off, Rahane comes forward to defend but is struck on his front pad. England appeal but the umpire declines instantly as he is hit way outside the line of the off stump.
Too wide of off to entice Kohli into a shot.

FOUR! The 100-run stand comes up and India need another 123 runs to win. Stokes strays in his line as he fires this on a length on Kohli's pads. He comes inside the line of the ball and tucks it away to beat the man at fine leg to pick up another boundary. The Indian pair marches on. Another milestone that Kohli will be proud of, he becomes the fastest to complete 4000 Test runs as a captain.
Stokes lands this on a back of a length and a bit wider of off, Kohli lets it go past.
Pulls the length back a bit and keeps it a bit outside off, Rahane hangs back in his crease, opens the bat face and takes a single by playing it towards the point region.
A bit fuller by Stokes on the middle and off line, Rahane defends with a straight bat.
Lands this on a length in line with the stumps. Rahane waits for the ball to arrive and blocks it under his eyeline.
Tossed up full ball on off, Kohli leans forward and wrists it into the mid-wicket region and they take a brace.
Ali floats it on the off stump line, Kohli hangs in his crease and keeps it out.
Rahane sees that the length is a bit shorter on this one and he rocks back and across, turns it with the spin towards the square leg region for a single.
Similar delivery  is dealt with similarly by the Indian vice-captain.
Rahane comes ahead and dead-bats this fuller one on off.
Kohli and Rahane are batting really well at the moment. England need to break this stand quickly or else the game will slip away from them.
Ali bowls a loopy one on off. Rahane does well to come forward and smother the spin.
Ends the over with a fullish delivery, angling in but just outside off, Kohli shoulders arms.
Stokes lands this on a bit shorter of a good length around off, Kohli goes back and defends from within the crease.
Wider of off and Kohli has nothing to do with it.
Just a bit wider of off, that is enough for Kohli to let it go.

What a beauty! This is a Stokes special. He fires it into Kohli, lands it on a length and gets the ball to move away on landing. Kohli, seeing the initial line, looks to defend but the away movement beats his tentative push. Stokes has his hands on his head.
Starts off with a fullish ball outside off, Kohli is not tempted into the drive.
Ben Stokes comes into the attack. Can he break this stand?
Oohs and Aahs from the Englishmen! Spinning in sharply, some extra bounce there. Rahane fends it off just in front of the man at leg gully. That was not far away.
Strides ahead to the loopy ball and deals with it nicely.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shot! Tossed up on a fuller length outside off, Kohli drills it to sweeper cover to rotate strike.
Rahane taps it towards cover-point and takes a quick run.
Tossed up ball around off, Rahane comes forward and blocks it nicely.
Keeps this on a length but just wife of the stumps. Kohli raise his bat to let that one go behind.

FOUR! Majestic flick! That's the 19th Test fifty for the Indian skipper and what an important one it is for his side. Jimmy attacks the stumps as he lands this on a fuller length on middle and leg. Kohli lets the ball come to him and flicks it to the deep square leg boundary. He raises his bat towards the dressing room. India need him to go on.
Anderson gets his line tighter and lands it on a middle and off line. Kohli watchfully defends it off the back foot.
Lands it on a length around off, Kohli confidently comes ahead and blocks it out.
Keeps it outside off, Kohli leaves it alone.
Starts the new over with a length ball outside off, Kohli lets it be. The ball stayed low as it reaches Bairstow.
Well bowled by Ali. He gives it a bit more air and keeps it on the off stump line. Rahane comes forward, takes the inward turn into account and dead-bats it nicely.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Rahane comes forward and blocks it out.
Rahane gets behind the line of this one and keeps it out.
A bit fuller outside off, Kohli leans forward and drives neatly towards covers for a single.
Moeen pulls his length back a bit, Kohli goes back and defends solidly.
That one took off! Pitches on the rough and then spins in sharply to take Kohli by surprise. He somehow fends it off towards the vacant leg gully region.
Kohli gets behind this back of a length delivery on off and taps it towards the cover-point region for a single.
Anderson keeps it a bit wider of off and Kohli shoulders arms.
Fuller and straighter, Kohli drives it to mid on.
Keeps it a bit short of a length around off, Rahane taps it neatly towards point for a single.

Big appeal for LBW again. Jimmy asking questions here. Keeps it on a fuller length just around off, Rahane shuffles a bit and comes forward looking to block it away but the ball hits the deck and nips back in sharply rapping him on his front pad. Jimmy and the slip cordon appeal loudly but the umpire answers in the negative. Replays roll in and the ball is seen missing the leg stump.
A length ball on off is defended well by Kohli. The ball rolls down towards the mid-wicket region and the batsmen cross over for a single.
Tossed up very full on off, Kohli crisply drives it to mid on and runs a quick single.

Big appeal, but that is nowhere near being close. Kohli comes well forward to this flighted one outside off. It's the googly which misses Kohli's inside edge and raps him on the front pad. The Englishmen go up in unison but the umpire turns it down. Replays show that the impact is way outside off.
A slower flighted delivery on middle and leg is flicked towards the square leg region for a single.
Floated around off, Kohli opens the bat face to glide it towards the point region and takes a single.
Slips in a googly this time but strays in his line. Rahane reads it early, goes back and tucks it round the corner for three runs. 100 up for India and it is met with a good cheer from the crowd.
Rashid starts off the new over with a very full loopy delivery around off,  Rahane comes forward and dead-bats it.
On a good length on middle, worked around the corner for a single.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Good running! Kohli taps the short of a length ball towards gully and takes off and his partner responds nicely. A run taken.

Anderson almost outfoxes Kohli there! That zone outside off is what Kohli needs to guard against. In the corridor of uncertainty, angled in initially but after landing, the ball nips away. Virat pokes at it and the ball whizzes past his outside edge. Jimmy needs to target that area consistently, he has tasted great success there.
On a length outside off, played with an angled blade past the point region for a single.
Full length ball around off, Rahane reaches the pitch of the ball and defends it down the track.
A googly outside off, Kohli reads it correctly and places it towards point.
Loopy delivery around off, Kohli puts his head down and blocks it nicely.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Rashid is bowling too quick for his team's liking. Kohli goes back and tucks it to the leg side with ease.
Skids through after landing on the track, Kohli covers his off stump and makes a good leave.
Short and outside off, kept out with ease off the back foot.
On a good length around off, Ajinkya shuffles a touch and stonewalls it.
On a length outside off, steered to third man for a single.
Full length ball around off, Kohli comes forward and blocks it with authority.
There is a run out appeal against Kohli at the striker's end. A brilliant direct hit from the man in deep but Virat seems to be safe.

Good game awareness from the duo! Back of a length outside off, Virat dabs it towards third man and calls his partner through for the second run. He is running to the danger end as the throw from Bairstow in the deep hits the bull's eye. It is taken upstairs. The replay shows that the Indian skipper is easily in. He is lightning quick between the wickets.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
That was a good nut from Anderson! On a good length outside off, moves away little after landing. Rahane feels for it and almost edges it behind.
On a shorter length, Rahane nails the pull towards deep square leg. Ali stationed there moves to his left and dives to make a great stop. A single taken.
Quick and flat on middle, Rahane hangs back and stonewalls it.

Well played! Fuller in length around off, Kohli comes ahead and drills it towards mid off. Broad moves to his right, dives but fails to stop it cleanly. Jennings from mid on chases it down and slides near the fence to keep the batsmen down to three.
The wrong one from Rashid but it is going down the leg side. Turned with ease through square leg for a single.
Tossed up around off, kept out watchfully.
Slower through the air on off, Ajinkya leans ahead and defends it right under his nose.

Time for Drinks! This has been an absorbing passage of play. Ajinkya Rahane and Virat Kohli have done really well to see off this phase and have kept the scoreboard ticking as well. Moeen Ali was amidst a good spell but he couldn't breach past this pair. India need to keep up the good work while England will be aiming for a breakthrough. India still need 159 runs to win. A tough tussle between bat and ball awaits.
Smart thinking from Anderson! Pitches on a good length around off and nips away a touch this time. Kohli shuffles a touch and defends it tentatively.
Anderson tries to bring the catching mid-wicket into play who has just moved in but ends up bowling this one down the leg side. Rahane easily works it through square leg for a single.
Nicely done! On a good length outside off, straightens a touch after landing. Rahane waits for it and glides it towards third man for a brace.
Full length ball in the corridor, Ajinkya puts his head down and defends it calmly.
The shiny side is on the inside and Anderson generates some reverse on this. Kohli leans ahead and taps it through cover-point to rotate strike.
Back of a length outside off, Kohli doesn't flirt with danger.
James Anderson is back on.
Whoosh! That one was venomous. Lands on the rough and takes off like an aeroplane. Rahane is taken aback and he tries to fend it off but takes a blow on the arm. That will hurt.
Spinning in substantially, Ajinkya is right back as he works it with the spin towards square leg.
Around the rough patch, Ajinkya is right forward to the pitch of the ball and blocks it nicely.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Slower through the air, Rahane lunges forward in defense.

He has found the gap but Bairstow in the deep does extremely well! Spins in viciously from the rough, Kohli makes use of the depth of the crease and turns it through square leg. Jonny in the deep hares to his right and dives full length to save a run for his side.
Similar delivery, no trouble at all for Jinx to deal with it.
Tossed up on middle and off, kept out watchfully.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Well played! Slips in the googly, Kohli camps back and whips it through mid-wicket. Will get a couple for doing so.
Not much spin on this one as he tucks it through mid-wicket to change strike.
Kohli leans ahead to the flighted ball and plays it against the spin through square leg for a run.
Slower through the air, Jinx comes ahead and blocks it with authority.
Loopy full ball around off, Ajinkya dead-bats it.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Virat goes deep in the crease and turns this one through mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Full ball outside off, eased towards covers for a single.
Was an edge present there? No there wasn't. Explodes from the rough and spins in with extra bounce, taking Rahane's thigh pad and flying over the leg gully fielder.
Fractionally short, kept out from the comfort of the crease.
Driven with the spin to covers.
Well bowled! Gives this one more revs, Kohli goes for an expansive drive through the line but gets a bottom edge as the ball rolls down the track. Stokes likes it at first slip.
Kohli covers the line to the floated ball and defends it under his eyes.
Comes ahead to the tossed up ball and defends it.
Tossed up outside off, Virat leaves it alone.
Takes off from the rough as Rahane is hit on the pads.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Not a bad way to play Ali on this track. When you commit yourself, you should commit completely. Comes ahead confidently and though he can't handle the sharp spin on this, he takes it on the pads.
Spinning into Rahane who turns it towards short leg.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floated around off, dealt with expertly.
Quicker one outside off, left alone.

FOUR! Pure timing on that one! A boundary after almost 8 overs. It's the conventional leg spinner from Rashid but it is on a shorter length. Allows Kohli to rock back and whip it through mid-wicket. There is no chance for the man in the deep to cut it off. That brings the 50-run stand between the duo. They have calmed the nerves in the dressing room but they need to carry on.
The conventional leg spinner from Rashid as Kohli punches it towards covers.
Around off, not much spin on that one. Ajinkya places it through wide mid on for a single.
Fullish ball, tapped towards mid off with the spin.
Slower through the air, Rahane strides ahead and blocks it nicely.
Quicker one outside off, Rahane glides it to third man for a single.
Fuller in length, Rahane comes ahead to take the spin out of the equation and dead-bats it.
Rahane makes use of the depth of the crease and turns this one with the spin to the leg side.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Floated well outside off, Ajinkya pushes at it but gets it off the outer half towards third man. A couple taken.
Turn and bounce as it spins back appreciably, Rahane tries to defend but is hit on the pads.

England are in the thick of things! Another appeal turned down. Rashid slips in the googly and gets a good amount of purchase from the track. Kohli takes a big stride ahead to counter the inward spin but is struck on the pads. Rashid pleads for it but the umpire shakes his head. Doing too much perhaps.
Pitches around leg stump, Kohli comes ahead to smother the turn but is hit on the pads. An appeal ensues but that wasn't going to be given.
Outside off, skids through after landing. Virat leaves it on its way.
In line of the stumps this time, Virat clears his front leg to keep it at bay.
Almost a replica of the previous delivery as Virat doesn't commit himself to it.
Starts off with a straighter one outside off, Kohli plants his front foot across and makes an assured leave.
Adil Rashid to roll his arm over now. Let's see how he uses the rough patch.
Brings his bat and pad close together and answers it with a straight bat.
On a flatter trajectory, Rahane hangs back and kills it on the pitch.
Slower through the air, defended solidly off the front foot.
Spinning in from around off, Rahane leans ahead and smothers the turn. Good way to play such deliveries, with your head on top of the ball.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

That was a highly optimistic appeal! Tossed up ball well outside off, it is a good shot selection from Rahane as he tries to fetch it from outside off but the execution is not proper. Ends up missing it to get hit on the pads and that draws a shout from the Englishmen. The umpire doesn't give a positive response. The impact was a country mile outside off.
Full length ball outside off, kept out watchfully. A maiden for Broad.
Full ball attacking the stumps, Kohli is up to it as he shuffles a touch and drives it crisply to mid on.
On a driveable length outside off, the Indian skipper strokes it with good timing to the cover region.
On a good length outside off, it is that channel which is tempting to feel for. However, Kohli is circumspect in his approach and allows it go through.
In the tight off stump corridor again, Virat covers the line of the ball and defends it with a straight bat.
Pitched up ball around off, Kohli puts his head down and with a high elbow blocks it right under his eyes.
Ali continues to probe in around that rough patch. Rahane comes ahead to the pitch of the ball to kill it on the turf.
Floated around off again, defended solidly off the front foot.
Slower through the air, Ajinkya comes ahead and smothers the turn.
If he missed that, he would have been a candidate for an LBW! Quicker in pace and spinning in sharply from around off, Rahane instead of coming forward decides to stay back. Keeps it out eventually.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated outside off on a fullish length, Kohli drills it nicely towards sweeper cover for a single.
In the avenue of apprehension, holding its line. Rahane doesn't fall for the bait and lets it through.
Back of a length outside off, played with an open bat face towards point.
Nice and crisp! Fractionally overpitched around off, Kohli leans ahead and strokes it through extra cover. The timing is really good and he gets three good runs for it.
That was a similar delivery to the one that got KL Rahul out! On a length outside off, keeps low. Kohli shuffles a touch and somehow keeps it out.
Almost a replica of the previous delivery as Virat points his bat skywards to let it go.
On a length well outside off, Kohli doesn't flirt with danger.
Loopy delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Shorter in length outside off, punched away for a single.
Allows the ball to spin back and clips it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Slow through the air around off, eased to mid off.

Safe! The impact has come to the rescue of Kohli! He must have had his heart in his mouth. A brilliant decision from Dharmasena, this. England have exhausted both their reviews now. Coming back to the ball, it is tossed up on the rough patch outside off. Virat camps back to deal with it but the ball keeps extremely low to go past his defense and he is hit flush on the pads. Ali and Co. rise up in a vociferous appeal but the umpire stays put. Root has a chat with his mates and immediately takes the DRS. Time for the replays. Hawk Eye shows that the impact is outside off and that is the end of the story.
Kohli has been bamboozled by a delivery which has kept very low. He has been struck in front and Root has quite quickly challenged the decision. Will the impact save the Indian skipper?
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
FOUR! Easy pickings! These are easy runs on offer for Rahane. He moves inside the line to a delivery which is going down the leg side and tickles it fine past the keeper to pick up a boundary.
Outside off, third leave in a row from Rahane.
A bit wider of off stump, Ajinkya doesn't fiddle with it.
Fuller in length outside off, left alone.

A big, big appeal for a caught behind falls on deaf ears! Was there an inside edge? Probably not. Good length ball outside off, nipping in after landing. Rahane tries to block it but seems to have missed it. The ball goes off something behind to Buttler who takes it and appeals. Root and Broad join in but the umpire is unmoved. England don't go for the review. Rightly so, as the replays show there was no inside edge. It was pretty close to the glove for comfort though.
This one takes off from a length on the fifth stump channel. Rahane knows where his off stump is and makes an assured leave.
Leans ahead and across to the tossed up ball and defends it besides the pitch on the leg side.
Leans ahead to the tossed up ball and defends it nicely.
Looped up nicely, spinning in. Virat comes ahead gingerly to block it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
FOUR! Nicely played! He is good through that area. This one is fullish and there is some width outside off. Kohli frees his arms and drives it with an open bat face through point to find the fence.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Kohli has to be careful! No need to play such expansive strokes. Tossed up outside off, Virat goes for a booming drive but gets an inside edge down the track.
That was a well judged single! Fuller in length around off, Kohli strokes it crisply towards mid off and sets off. Takes on Anderson's arm and makes him falter.

Stokes is not happy, he knows that every run matters in a close contest. In the corridor outside off, Rahane pushes at it but gets it off the outer half towards Ben at gully. He dives to his right and misfields, allowing a single.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Ajinkya shows the full face of the bat and caresses it to mid off.
Broad drags his length back a touch, Jinx waits for it and plays it with an angled bat towards point.
Broad pitches this one full, allowing the ball to do its thing in the air. It swings in as Ajinkya comes ahead and pats it down the track.
Broad starts off his new spell with a good length ball around off, Ajinkya hangs back and taps it nicely towards mid off.
Stuart Broad to bowl from the other end.
On a flatter trajectory, skids after landing. Virat hangs back and presents a water-tight defense.
Fuller in length on middle and off, eased back towards the bowler.
Rahane makes use of the depth of the crease and turns it with the spin to the man at 45 for a run.

Well bowled! Gives this one more revs outside off and gets it to dip into Rahane. He prods forward to deal with it but is hit on the pads. No real appeal as such from England as the impact was well outside off.
On a shorter length, goes straight on, Ajinkya hangs back and blocks it nicely.
Tossed up around off, Rahane comes forward and defends it with his bat and pad close together.
We are back for the afternoon session. Virat Kohli and Ajinkya Rahane to resume their innings. Moeen Ali to continue his spell.
... Day 4, Session 2 ...

The Indian skipper and his deputy have a mountain of a task ahead of them. The English bowlers maintained tight lines and lengths throughout the session, not giving any freebies to the visiting batsmen. Will we see the no. 1 Test team fight back and make a match out of this? We will soon find out. Join us on the other side of the break.

England are right on top as we enter the Lunch break in this exciting and enthralling battle. Their tail couldn't wag for long this morning but the way they have bowled has put them in a position of immense strength. India have lost their top order quickly and they will have their hopes pinned on the current pair of Virat Kohli and Ajinkya Rahane.
Bouncer from Sam. Kohli ducks under this one. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 4!
Fuller on middle, Kohli leans forward and eases it to mid-wicket.
Lands this one on a shorter of a length outside off, Rahane opens the bat face to guide it towards the point region for a single.
Keeps it on a length on off, Rahane defends it with the full face of the bat.

Safe! The impact has turned out to be Rahane's savior! Fabulous use of the review by the tourists. They cannot afford to lose another wicket before Lunch. Sam, from around the wicket, angles it into Rahane. Lands it on a fuller length as Ajinkya comes forward to block it out. The ball pitches and continues to come into Rahane who pushes at it but gets beaten by the inward movement and the ball raps him on his front pad. England appeal loudly and the umpire raises his finger. The hosts are ecstatic but the batsmen chat and decide to challenge the decision. Hawk Eye shows that the impact is outside off stump and the decision is overturned. Rahane will continue to battle on. Can the pair go on to build a longer partnership?
Rahane has been given out LBW but he takes the DRS after having a chat with his skipper. The impact might save him.
Sam fires it full outside off, Rahane shoulders arms.
Tossed up on off, it is defended off the front foot.
Floated around middle and off, Rahane flicks it away into the mid-wicket region for a single.
Ali drags it short this time, Rahane rocks back quickly and pulls it towards the deep square leg region to take a brace.
A bit quicker and fuller outside off, Rahane goes back to flick it but the turns beats his inside edge and he gets rapped on his pads. England appeal but half-heartedly. The umpire declines it.
Slower and fuller on middle, Rahane wrists it away towards the square leg region.
Tossed up ball on off, Rahane goes back and defends.
Sam pulls the length back and keeps it on off, Kohli comes behind the line of the ball nicely and keeps it out.
Lands it just outside off, angling further away from the batsman who lets it go past.
A bit shorter in length on off, Kohli opens the bat face to tap it towards point.
A bit fuller on middle stump line, Kohli drives it to mid on.
Similar ball, Kohli again watchfully lets it go.
Starts off with a length ball outside off, Kohli shoulders arms.
Sam Curran comes into the attack.
Rahane comes right forward to this full delivery on off and defends it solidly.
Floated outside off, Kohli goes back and pushes it towards covers for a single.
Tossed up on off, Kohli defends with the full face of the bat.

Not out! England lose a review. It looked close to the naked eye. Ali tosses this one up and lands it outside off, on the rough patch. The ball turns in sharply as Kohli is looking to block it off the front foot. It beats the Indian skipper's inside edge who gets rapped on the front pad. England instantly appeal but the umpire turns it down. The hosts discuss and decide to go upstairs. Replays rolls in. Snicko shows that the bat and pad are close to each other. There is a spike when the ball goes past but I am not sure whether it is because of the inside edge or the bat hitting the pad. The on-field call stands. The TV umpire felt that the spike was because of the bat being involved. England certainly don't agree as they are not happy.
This can be a big moment in the game. A review taken by Root and it is against Kohli regarding an LBW decision. This looks close.
Ali fires it on Kohli's pads who goes back and flicks it towards the square leg region. The batsmen take a brace.
Tossed up around off, Rahane comes forward and drives through covers for a single.

Stokes fires it just behind a length, angling into the batsman, Kohli walks inside the line of the ball and tucks it away towards the fine leg region. The fielder there does well to dive and stop it from crossing the boundary. They get two.
Keeps it a bit back of a length, Kohli defends off the back foot.
Rahane comes behind the line of this back of a length delivery on off, opens the face of the bat and nudges it towards the point region for a single.
A length delivery on off is blocked out off the front foot.
Kohli comes across and steers a single through backward point.
Stokes fires it in on a length angling into Rahane who leans forward and flicks it towards the mid-wicket region. The timing on that one is good enough for the batsmen to cross over for the third.
Floated around the off stump, Kohli gets behind the line and keeps it out.
Moeen lands this on middle and leg, Kohli wrists it away to mid-wicket.
Similar ball and similar block by Kohli.
Tossed up ball on off, Kohli defends off the front foot.
Leg Bye! A tossed up delivery on middle and leg. Rahane tries to flick it but gets rapped on the pads. The balls dribbles down towards fine leg and the batsmen cross over for a run.
Tossed up full ball on off, Kohli drives it to covers for a single.
Length ball outside off, Rahane has nothing to do with it.

Beaten! Wow, what a ball! That one landed on a length just on off stump, Rahane tries to come behind the line but the ball lands and moves away prodigiously to beat his outside edge. An 83 mph leg cutter from the English all-rounder.
Full length ball on off, Rahane defends off the front foot.
Angles this one into Rahane, but strays it down the leg side. Rahane tried to flick it away but missed.
A bit shorter of a length on off, Rahane comes behind the line of the delivery and defends.
Keeps it just short of a length on off, Rahane stands tall and blocks.
Ben Stokes into the attack.
Fullish delivery on Kohli's pads, who flicks it to the fielder at square leg.
Fuller and straighter, pushed to mid on.

Half-hearted appeal from England. Ali keeps this full outside off, Kohli comes forward looking to defend. The ball dips and turns on pitching. Kohli is hit on his front pad. England appeal but the umpire rejects. He was hit just outside off.
Very full on off, Kohli wrists it away towards mid on.
Tossed up around off, Kohli comes right forward and defends.
Ali starts his spell with a flighted delivery on off. Kohli blocks it off the front foot.
Moeen Ali comes into the attack.
Lands it on a length but outside off. Rahane shoulders arms.
Pulls the length back, keeps it just outside off. Kohli opens the face of his bat and runs it down to the third man region to exchange strike.
A length ball around off is defended off the front foot.

Inside edge towards fine leg. Broad keeps it on a length on off. Rahane comes forward looking to block it out. The ball lands, nips in and takes a thick inside edge of Rahane's bat. The ball rolls down towards the deep square leg area. The batsmen think of two but decide against it at the last moment.
Broad fires this one a bit straighter on Kohli's pads who waits in his crease, lets the ball come near him and wrists it away into the square leg region for a single.
Starts off with a fullish length delivery outside off. Rahane comes forward and defends with a slightly open face. The ball runs towards the deep point region and they take a single.
Jimmy continues with the probing line and length. Kohli is up to the task as he defends solidly by coming right behind the line of the delivery. Maiden over by Anderson.
A bit short of a length on off, Kohli stays back and blocks it out.
Similar ball and a similar block from the Indian skipper.
Keeps it on a length around off. Kohli defends off the front foot.

Lands this one fuller and a bit outside off. Kohli leans ahead and tries to drive through the cover region. He's early into the drive and gets the inner half of the bat. The ball rolls down towards mid on.
Starts the new over with a length ball on off stump. Kohli comes right forward to keep it out.
Ends the over with a similar delivery. Length ball just outside off, Rahane watchfully lets it go behind.
Pulls the length back a bit but keeps it just outside off, Rahane shoulders  arms.
Keeps it on a good length on middle and off. Rahane blocks it out.
Lands it on a fullish length just around off, Kohli comes forward nicely and pushes it to the left of mid off and takes a single.
Fuller on off this time, Rahane leans forward and drives it towards the cover-point area. They quickly take a single. It's Kohli vs Broad time.
Broad starts the new over with a good length ball around off. Rahane comes forward and blocks it out.
Short of a length ball, angling in from outside off, Virat turns it defensively towards short leg. A successful over for England.
On a good length outside off, Ajinkya taps it through point and gets off the mark.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Ajinkya Rahane is the new man in. He has a calm head on his shoulders. Can he take India to safe harbours along with the skipper?

OUT! India are in all sorts of troubles! Anderson is in tremendous rhythm and is running through them. He lands this one on a length around off and there is some nibble in the air. Dhawan gets squared up as he comes a touch forward and pushes at it but gets a thick outside edge behind. Stokes who is stationed in the gully region gets low to his left and takes a brilliant catch. That was traveling at a fast pace and he did extremely well to pouch it. England are cock-a-hoop at the moment. They need 7 more wickets to win this game while the visitors are still 223 runs adrift of where they have to be.
Slips this one down the leg side and it is pretty short. Shikhar tries to tuck it away but misses.
There is an issue with the ball and the umpires have a look at it.
FOUR! Beautiful! Anderson does the mistake of bowling this one pretty full and is too straight as well. Dhawan covers the line and flicks it nonchalantly in front of square leg to find the fence.
Gets it to land on a length just around off, Kohli does well to get behind the line of the ball and keep it out.
A good length ball on off, Dhawan comes forward and tries to keep it out. Gets a thick outside edge and the ball rolls in the gap towards the third man area. They cross over to change strike.
Fuller on off, Dhawan leans forward and drives it to mid on.
Lands it on a length around off, Dhawan defends with a straight bat.
Beaten again! Broad pulls the length back a bit, Dhawan from his crease looks to block, the ball moves away again and luckily for Dhawan beats his bat again.
Beaten! Broad looking dangerous. Hits the good length area around off. Dhawan looking to play the front foot defense is beaten due to the away movement on the ball.
Virat Kohli comes out to bat. A captain's knock is the need of the hour.

OUT! The height does not save him! It is umpire's call though and hence, India do not lose their review but they lose their first innings' hero Pujara. Certainly a big blow for India. Anderson keeps it on a length on off stump. Pujara, from within the crease, looks to keep it out. The ball nips in on pitching, beats Che's inside edge and hits him on his back pad. England appeal confidently and the umpire obliges. Pujara has a chat with Shikhar who advises him to go for the DRS. Time for the replays. There is nothing on Snicko. Hawk Eye rolls in now and shows that the ball is hitting in line and it is clipping the top of the stumps. The on-field call stays. Worrying times for the tourists.
Pujara has been trapped in front of the stumps but after having a chat with his partner, he goes for the review. Looks out to the naked eye. Only the height can save him.
A bit shorter in length, Pujara goes back and keeps it out.
On a length around off, Pujara defends off the front foot.

Continues to hit the corridor around off. Dhawan comes forward to block, the ball nips away, takes a thick outside edge and flies through the vacant gully area. The substitute fielder, Pope, chases it down and keeps it down to three.

Beaten! Peach of a delivery from Anderson. He lands this one on a length just outside off. It lands and straightens. Dhawan trying to block it off the front foot is beaten because of the movement. Anderson has his hands on his head.
Jimmy keeps this one fuller outside off. Dhawan watchfully lets it go.
Strays on Pujara's pads who does not miss out. He flicks it into the square leg region and picks up two more.
Beaten! Broad gets this one to land on a length on off and nip away on landing. Pujara who is seen trying to play the initial line is beaten.
Pujara leaves this one outside his off stump.
A bit straighter on a length from Broad. Pujara turns it away into the square leg region. No run.
Lands it a bit full on off, Pujara comes forward and defends.
Braod starts off a new over with one that is just a bit shorter of good length around off. Pujara blocks it off the back foot.
Anderson strays on Pujara's pads who flicks this one to fine leg for a single.
A short of a length ball around off is tapped away towards the point region. The batsmen take a quick single.
Anderson keeps it on a length just outside off, Dhawan initially looks to play at it but at the last moment pulls his bat inside the line of the ball and lets it go past.
Keeps it full outside off, Dhawan leaves.

Jimmy fires this on a length on middle on leg. The ball swings in and moves further in on pitching. Dhawan, looking to whip it off his pads, misses it and gets rapped on the pads. Jimmy and the slip cordon roar in an appeal but the umpire turns it down. Missing leg, just.
Anderson lands it on a length around off, Pujara plays inside the line, with soft hands, the outside edge scurries away past the two slips and a gully. They take a single.
Lands it outside off, Dhawan leaves.

FOUR! Exquisite from Dhawan. Broad fires it on a fullish length angling into Dhawan. There is good inward movement on the ball and that beats Dhawan who is looking to lean across and turn it away into the leg side. The ball raps him on his pads and England appeal. The umpire though refuses as the ball is seen missing leg. It is high as well.

Lands it a bit shorter of a good length, Pujara from within his crease tries to keep it out, the ball hits the surface and moves away to get a thick outside edge. The batsmen take a single as the ball rolls to the vacant third man area.
Fires this on a length on his pads, Pujara flicks it straight to the fielder at square leg.
Keeps it full and wide of off. Pujara leaves.
Cheteshwar Pujara in next to bat.

OUT! Hard luck, Rahul! He could have barely done anything about it. England strike early. Broad keeps it on a good length around off and it doesn't take off at all. Rahul hangs back in his crease and looks to block it out but is undone completely as he is late to bring his bat down. The ball keeps very low, around shin height, takes the bottom edge of Rahul's bat and uproots the off pole. His poor form continues. India are one down, they have been jolted.
The ball is too wide to entice Dhawan into a shot.

Big appeal for LBW. Jimmy fires this one into Dhawan's pads who tries to flick it through the leg side. The ball comes in on pitching and the southpaw is hit on the pads. The English team go up with an appeal but the umpire declines it. Replays show the ball was missing leg.
Keeps it a bit back of a length outside off, Dhawan lets it go.

FOUR! Streaky but India will take them however they come. Jimmy bowls this one in the corridor of uncertainty. Dhawan comes forward to block. There is a bit of away movement on landing which takes the thick outside edge of Shikhar's bat. The ball flies past the vacant gully region to the boundary. The tourists get their first boundary of the innings.
A bit wider of off and Shikhar shoulders arms again.
Starts from round the wicket, lands it on a fullish length just outside off, Dhawan lets it go behind.
Rahul lets this one go outside the off stump.
A bit shorter and a bit wider of off this time, Rahul shoulders arms.
Length around off, Rahul comes forward and defends confidently.
Similar delivery to the last one. Rahul again tentatively looks to block it out. The ball lands and moves away prodigiously. Rahul is beaten but is seen acknowledging the delivery.
Beaten! Better from Broad as he keeps it a bit fuller this time just around off. The ball pitches and nips away a bit. Rahul, looking to defend off the front foot is beaten by the movement.
Broad starts off with a back of a length delivery around off. Rahul stays back in his crease and keeps it out.
Stuart Broad to start from the other end. Three slips in place for him, like Anderson.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Landed on a length and moving away, arms are shouldered once again.
Another leave from Dhawan. Sees the ball landing well away from him outside off, so has nothing to do with it.
Fuller and wider outside off, left alone.

Oh that was close! Dhawan should consider himself extremely, extremely lucky. Coming back in from around off, on a back of a length, Dhawan surprisingly offers no shot and is rapped high on the pads. A loud shout goes up but umpire Dharmasena doesn't budge. England think long and hard about the review but don't go for it. Good call too as replays show height would have been an issue.
Starts off from around the wicket and angles in a length ball on off, Dhawan gets behind the line and blocks.
